exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: cohort.minimum_observation: exclude participants with fewer than 30 full days of data; 57 of 202 excluded

inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer count of source-qualified full data days per participant.
outputBoundary: Exclude a participant only when the supplied full-day count is strictly below 30; retain equality and larger counts.
limitations: The source does not define the event coverage required for a day to qualify as a full day.
This binding does not assign timestamps to calendar days or select a timezone.
This binding does not group day evidence or derive participant-level full-day counts.
A missing participant count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
The reported 57-of-202 exclusion count is descriptive evidence, not asserted as a fixture oracle without participant data.
